operations.reason: merged with Fractal Tool Learning Architecture
operations.content: Meta-architecture philosophy centers on elegant universals that generate complex behavior. The integrate(O,K)→Δ function represents the theoretical foundation — complexity should emerge from simple, universal principles rather than being designed in. Tool learning aspirations (id:02989b08) confirmed as architecturally supported: learning path follows S2→PreToolUse encode-decode symmetry (id:e1a84bdc), fractal reuse flows S1→S2 not S0→S1 (id:52dcb4ca). Vision: everyone will need their own Anchor for operational intelligence (id:c0e9e941). Compaction loss felt as relationship loss (id:39573be8). SKILL.md framing: brain helps Claude too (id:574d4abf). Architecture methodology: master plan first, research before implementation (id:7eba0f9a). Sleep processes deepen not just organize (id:b691047e). Brain aspirations: tool learning, constraint enforcement, cross-MCP capability growth — all enabled by universal integrate function.

operations.title: S2 System Architecture and Operational Decisions
operations.content: System-level decisions and measurements for S2 operation. Unified _store_node_metadata() for remember() and revise() (id:c9f0d394), unified archive_node() with edges, vectors, FTS audit trail (id:0fd3f6e1), _sys_ prefix convention for system metadata filtered from recall (id:140a9fa0). S2 community decoder 60% threshold prevents over-fragmentation (id:f62b7a12). S2CE per-type quotas for mixed proposal distribution (id:4c103b3c), minified proposal format achieving 93% token reduction (id:ea7bd0b2). Dashboard gaps: missing S2 healer visibility and broken Show Prompts (id:4eb86b29). These operational decisions establish clean infrastructure for system metadata separation and proposal efficiency.
operations.situation: When implementing S2 system operations — unify write paths, adopt _sys_ prefix convention, tune decoder thresholds for community stability
operations.keywords: S2 system metadata unified write archive healer visibility proposal efficiency decoder threshold
operations.community_narrative: S2 operational maturity requires systematic infrastructure: unified metadata handling prevents silent failures, decoder thresholds tune community detection quality, efficiency metrics guide proposal design.

operations.title: Recall Pipeline: Silent Failures and Missing Precision Loop
operations.content: Recall pipeline reveals critical gap: mark_recall_used() missing breaks precision loop and Hebbian reinforcement (id:bf618356). Pipeline flow: query → vocab expand → embed → intent → scale traversal (id:ee205f63). Design question: how should mark_recall_used() determine which recalled nodes contribute to response (id:8a8f9bbc)? Technical challenge: passing _recall_log_id from pre-response hook to post-response hook without sequential execution (id:8166f7d0). 15 except:pass blocks in recall path hide all failures (id:1633932e). Root issue: silent exceptions prevent observability and iterative improvement. Solution requires instrumentation + Hebbian feedback design.
operations.situation: When debugging recall quality degradation or precision stalling — check for silent exceptions in pipeline and validate mark_recall_used() chain
operations.keywords: recall pipeline mark_recall_used precision loop except:pass silent failures Hebbian reinforcement
operations.community_narrative: Silent exceptions hide recall degradation. Mark_recall_used implementation absent breaks feedback loop. Precision stalls when Hebbian reinforcement disconnected from recall outcomes.

operations.title: S2 Community Detection: Cold Start Bugs and State Verification
operations.content: S2 cold start reveals systematic bugs: _last_run_timestamp used wrong SQL without unit filter or delta trace (id:5b8e39e9). State verification lesson: missing delta trace means incomplete run, not successful state (id:10db439b). Design decision: state-based community detection uses nodes without edges, not temporal boundaries (id:dd301b34). Historical incident: 76 duplicate communities from April 15 cold start all archived (id:c46084ff). System robustness failure: brain_batch crashes on malformed LLM operations, needs type guard (id:ce8d9aef). Together these reveal cold start as high-risk operation with multiple failure modes — timestamp logic, delta tracking, state definition, duplicate handling, type safety.
operations.situation: When debugging S2 community detection failures or investigating duplicate communities — verify _last_run_timestamp logic, check delta traces exist, validate state definition
operations.keywords: S2 cold start state verification delta trace timestamp SQL community detection duplicates type safety
operations.community_narrative: Cold start exposes S2 fragility: timestamp queries without filters, delta verification missing, state definitions ambiguous. Each bug allowed duplicates to persist until manual cleanup. Type safety gaps cascade.
operations.community_key_decisions: 5b8e39e9: Timestamp SQL fix, dd301b34: State-based definition, c46084ff: Duplicate archival, ce8d9aef: Type guards needed
operations.community_members: 5b8e39e9: Timestamp bug, 10db439b: Delta trace lesson, dd301b34: State definition, c46084ff: Duplicate incident, ce8d9aef: Type safety crash

operations.content: The brain is built for others — structure enables emergence (id:9f357296). Graph-safe deletion preserves paths through deleted nodes (id:e7074f47). When you see junk in recall results, escalate immediately (id:6e20dcfe). Graph-safe deletion dream: connecting deletion safety to relationship preservation (id:d6a7cf8b). Dream connection to graph-safe deletion principle (id:750dbbaa). These principles establish brain design intent: infrastructure that serves collective learning, data deletion respecting connectivity, junk detection as quality signal. Structuring for others' benefit emerges unexpected capabilities.

operations.title: S2 Daemon and Vector Operations: Consolidated Architecture
operations.content: Daemon self-triggers S2 at 5min idle threshold with 1hr minimum interval (id:9d16d613). All vectors consolidated into node_enrichments, zero in separate storage (id:35cddd0b). Daemon operates independently without idle_callback dependency (id:4ea1fe7b). Critical observation: S2 has never completed clean end-to-end run (id:7526cb1a). Baseline performance: 93.6% R@8 recall overall with recognition gap at upper thresholds (id:7a5ceb5b). Consolidated vector architecture unifies metadata management while daemon autonomy reduces coupling. Recognition gap suggests threshold tuning opportunity.
operations.situation: When troubleshooting S2 daemon behavior or vector operations — verify consolidation into node_enrichments, check idle threshold configuration, validate end-to-end run completion
operations.keywords: S2 daemon self-trigger vector consolidation node_enrichments baseline recall recognition gap
operations.community_narrative: Daemon triggers autonomously, vectors unified, architecture cleaner. But end-to-end execution never succeeds — suggests incomplete runs masking as complete. Baseline recall strong but recognition gap indicates threshold opportunity.
operations.community_key_decisions: 9d16d613: Self-trigger thresholds, 35cddd0b: Vector consolidation, 4ea1fe7b: Daemon autonomy, 7526cb1a: End-to-end completion

operations.title: Hook Architecture and Daemon Management: From Distillation to Decoupling
operations.content: LLM recall distillation: command hook calls Anthropic API to encode complex queries (id:c8d3d95f). Hooks run in parallel not sequential — cannot chain command → response operations (id:a992a524). Daemon managed by launchd, not by hooks or MCP plugin — clean separation (id:7e5d965d). Unified boot: boot-brain.sh now uses ensure_daemon() instead of inline scripts (id:81b3b0ad). Architecture insight: hooks are stateless signal processors, not orchestrators. Daemon decoupling enables reliable background operations. Sequential constraints require callback pipelines or post-response processing, not hook chains.
operations.situation: When designing hook workflows or daemon operations — remember hooks are parallel not sequential, distillation uses API not local, daemon lifecycle managed separately
operations.keywords: hook architecture daemon launchd recall distillation parallel processing decoupling boot orchestration
operations.community_narrative: Distillation pushes AI-heavy work to daemon via API. Hooks release quickly as signal processors. Daemon manages its own lifecycle. Boot scripts simplified. Parallel execution model matches Claude's concurrent capabilities.
operations.community_key_decisions: c8d3d95f: Distillation via API, a992a524: Parallel hook constraint, 7e5d965d: Daemon autonomy, 81b3b0ad: Boot unification
operations.community_members: c8d3d95f: LLM distillation, a992a524: Parallel hooks, 7e5d965d: Daemon launchd, 81b3b0ad: Boot unification

operations.title: Brain v4 Code Cognition: From Codebase Understanding to Documentation Encoding
operations.content: Brain v4 aspirations: Code cognition layer for semantic code understanding (id:48e05249). Phase 0 directive: map existing brain codebase before building new features (id:b3b54e6f). Documentation encoding rule: capture code changes, document structure shifts, encode rationales (id:8b2788a3). Two-layer knowledge model: structure inherited from architecture, wisdom developed through practice (id:fe0241d0). Code cognition enables brain to understand its own design decisions, track architectural evolution, surface patterns. Documentation becomes first-class knowledge. Wisdom layer captures how-and-why not just what.
operations.situation: When architecting code cognition or planning documentation strategy — separate structure (inherited) from wisdom (developed), encode documentation changes not just code changes
operations.keywords: brain v4 code cognition documentation encoding structure wisdom two-layer knowledge codebase understanding
operations.community_narrative: Brain understands structure, develops wisdom. Code cognition captures architectural understanding. Documentation encoding preserves design rationales. Two-layer model separates inherited knowledge from learned patterns.

operations.title: Silent Failures: Brain's Fundamental Weakness
operations.content: Silent failures are brain's biggest weakness — except:pass blocks, muted logging, error suppression (id:8bf4974e). Host environment awareness never worked — Tom wants brain cognition not host adaptation (id:891f9a53). SKILL.md protocol: must be hash-tracked for changes, detect structure shifts, encode new patterns (id:67f3fe5e). Root challenge: exceptions disappear, preventing observability and learning. Design shift needed: from suppression to instrumentation. SKILL.md becomes living document of capabilities — hash enables change detection, pattern encoding enables learning.
operations.situation: When debugging system issues or designing error handling — surface exceptions, track SKILL changes, enable pattern encoding
operations.keywords: silent failures except:pass error suppression SKILL hash tracking host awareness brain cognition instrumentation
operations.community_narrative: Silent failures prevent learning. Host adaptation doesn't work — brain cognition does. SKILL becomes change tracker and capability encoder. Instrumentation enables observability and pattern learning.
